text: Alexia [Gr. a + legein , to read]: Ger. Alexie ; Fr. alexie ; Ital. alessia . Loss or impairment of the power to read; i.e. to understand the meaning of the visual symbols expressed in printed or written words. It forms one of a group of the diseases of speech with intimate and important relations to other defects. See SPEECH AND ITS DEFECTS. Forms of alexia are termed word-blindness, text-blindness; and it is related to, though not synonymous with, mental or mind-blindness, called also PSYCHIC BLINDNESS (q.v.). ( J.J. )
